Scenario Name: Login as visual_user and identify 'Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt'
Steps: 1. LoginPage.open(); LoginPage.login('visual_user','secret_sauce'); 2. InventoryPage.expectLoaded(); 3. item = InventoryPage.inventoryItems.filter({hasText:'Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt'}); expect(item).toHaveCount(1) and toBeVisible(); 4. expect(item name locator).toHaveText('Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt')

Scenario Name: Authentication gate before product identification
Steps: 1. For valid visual_user/invalid/locked_out/empty credentials call LoginPage.login(user,pass); assert BasePage.expectUrlContains('/inventory.html') only for valid else LoginPage.expectLoginError(msg); 2. In a fresh context goto('/inventory.html') and assert redirect to login (loginButton visible; no inventory item visible)

Scenario Name: Product identifiable despite visual differences vs standard_user
Steps: 1. Login as standard_user; read name, price, description, image src of target in list and on detail page; 2. Repeat as visual_user in a new context; 3. Assert name identical and identifiable in both; 4. Annotate (test.info().annotations) any price/image/layout differences

Scenario Name: Login with visual_user
Steps: 1. LoginPage.open(); 2. LoginPage.login('visual_user','secret_sauce'); 3. BasePage.expectUrlContains('/inventory.html'); InventoryPage.expectLoaded(); 4. expect(LoginPage.errorMessage).toBeHidden()

Scenario Name: Target product displayed for visual_user
Steps: 1. Login as visual_user; 2. item = inventoryItems.filter({hasText:'Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt'}); expect(item).toHaveCount(1); 3. Assert image visible, price visible (annotate value vs $15.99), 'Add to cart' button visible

Scenario Name: Product name is an exact match
Steps: 1. Login as visual_user; 2. Read item name text (data-test 'inventory-item-name') of the target; 3. expect(name).toHaveText('Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt') (exact, case- and spacing-sensitive)

Scenario Name: Open product detail page by clicking name
Steps: 1. Login as visual_user; 2. Click the target name link; 3. BasePage.expectUrlContains('/inventory-item.html?id=1'); 4. Assert detail name = target, description and price visible

Scenario Name: Open product detail page by clicking image
Steps: 1. Login as visual_user; 2. Click the image within the filtered target item; 3. expectUrlContains('/inventory-item.html?id=1'); 4. Assert same name, description and price as name-link flow

Scenario Name: Back to products from detail page
Steps: 1. Login as visual_user; open target detail page; 2. Click 'back-to-products'; 3. expectUrlContains('/inventory.html'); InventoryPage.expectLoaded(); 4. Assert target item visible, count 1

Scenario Name: Identify product after each sort order
Steps: 1. Login as visual_user; 2. For each of ['za','lohi','hilo'] selectOption on 'product-sort-container'; 3. After each assert target toHaveCount(1) and visible; 4. Assert list order changes per sort

Scenario Name: Add identified product to cart
Steps: 1. Login as visual_user; 2. Click Add to cart within target item; 3. Assert button text 'Remove' and cart badge '1'; 4. Open cart and assert target listed

Scenario Name: Visual comparison of target card vs standard_user baseline
Steps: 1. Login as standard_user; screenshot target item locator; 2. Login as visual_user in a new context; screenshot target item; 3. Compare bounding boxes, image src and price; attach both screenshots; 4. Assert name text equal and visible in both; annotate differences

Scenario Name: Login with wrong password
Steps: 1. LoginPage.open(); 2. LoginPage.login('visual_user','wrong_pass'); 3. LoginPage.expectLoginError('Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in our service'); 4. Assert URL not /inventory.html and no inventory item visible

Scenario Name: Login with unknown username
Steps: 1. LoginPage.open(); 2. LoginPage.login('invalid_user','secret_sauce'); 3. expectLoginError(mismatch message); 4. goto('/inventory.html') redirects to login (no session)

Scenario Name: Login with locked_out_user
Steps: 1. LoginPage.open(); 2. LoginPage.login('locked_out_user','secret_sauce'); 3. expectLoginError('Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.'); 4. Assert inventory not reachable

Scenario Name: Login with empty username
Steps: 1. LoginPage.open(); 2. Fill only password 'secret_sauce'; click login; 3. expectLoginError('Epic sadface: Username is required')

Scenario Name: Login with visual_user and empty password
Steps: 1. LoginPage.open(); 2. Fill username 'visual_user', leave password blank; click login; 3. expectLoginError('Epic sadface: Password is required')

Scenario Name: Direct access to inventory without login
Steps: 1. In a fresh context BasePage.goto('/inventory.html'); 2. Assert redirect to login (loginButton visible); 3. Assert error mentions login required; 4. Assert no inventory items visible

Scenario Name: Direct access to product detail without login
Steps: 1. In a fresh context goto('/inventory-item.html?id=1'); 2. Assert redirect to login; 3. Assert no product name/price shown

Scenario Name: Non-existent product name (near matches)
Steps: 1. Login as visual_user; 2. For 'Sauce Labs Bolt Shirt' and 'Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirts' filter items by exact name regex ^name$; 3. expect count 0; 4. Confirm exact target count is 1

Scenario Name: Invalid product id on detail page
Steps: 1. Login as visual_user; 2. goto('/inventory-item.html?id=999'); 3. Assert no uncaught pageerror and empty/not-found state; 4. Assert target details not displayed

Scenario Name: Session ended then inventory revisited via Back
Steps: 1. Login as visual_user; InventoryPage.expectLoaded(); 2. Open menu and click logout; 3. page.goBack(); 4. Assert login page/error shown and inventory items not visible

Scenario Name: Page refresh on inventory keeps session
Steps: 1. Login as visual_user; 2. page.reload(); 3. expectUrlContains('/inventory.html'); 4. Assert target still visible with count 1

Scenario Name: Product uniqueness vs other T-Shirts
Steps: 1. Login as visual_user; 2. Count items hasText 'Bolt T-Shirt' -> 1; 3. Count items hasText 'T-Shirt' -> >= 2; 4. Assert 'Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red)' is a different item

Scenario Name: Name-based locator independent of position and layout shifts
Steps: 1. Login as visual_user; record target index; 2. For each sort order and after reload relocate by name; 3. Assert count 1 and visible each time; 4. Assert index differs for at least one sort

Scenario Name: Injection strings in login fields
Steps: 1. LoginPage.open(); register page.on('dialog') failing on any dialog; 2. LoginPage.login(\' OR '1'='1\"
Business Priority: '<script>alert(1)</script>'); 3. expectLoginError(mismatch message); 4. Assert no dialog and /inventory.html not reachable"

Scenario Name: Username case sensitivity and whitespace
Steps: 1. For 'Visual_User' and ' visual_user ' with 'secret_sauce' call LoginPage.login; 2. Assert mismatch error and login page for each; 3. Annotate observed whitespace behavior

Scenario Name: Cart state does not affect identification
Steps: 1. Login as visual_user; add target to cart; 2. goto('/inventory.html'); 3. Locate target by name, count 1; 4. Assert button text 'Remove'

Scenario Name: Cross-browser and mobile viewport rendering for visual_user
Steps: 1. Run with Playwright projects chromium, firefox, webkit and mobile viewport (375x667); 2. In each, login as visual_user and locate target; 3. Assert name visible, boundingBox width > 0 and not clipped (scrollWidth <= clientWidth)

Scenario Name: Visual glitches do not hide or overlap the product name
Steps: 1. Login as visual_user; 2. Get boundingBox of target name, image, price and Add to cart button; 3. Assert name visible, enabled to click, not overlapped by other elements (elementFromPoint at name center is the name link); 4. Attach screenshot and annotate overlaps/misalignment

Scenario Name: Consistency across repeated logins
Steps: 1. Loop 3 times: login as visual_user, record target name, price, image src and bounding box, logout; 2. Assert name constant on every iteration; 3. Annotate whether price/layout/image vary between sessions
